items.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
items.snippet: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

items.title: Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November
items.snippet: Binance will discontinue its mining pool and related services on Nov. 10, urging miners to move to alternative pools before the shutdown.

items.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
items.snippet: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as it decouples from tumbling Korean stocks and Nasdaq futures
items.snippet: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.
